reviewBody: Knight Group was professional, on time, honest, and very reasonably priced. We thought we needed a new door, but they were able to repair it instead and saved us a lot of money. Great work and highly recommend!

Nick from Knight’s group installed a shower bar for us. Came back twice after studying the problem so we could have 500 pounds of weight on the bar bought the bar for us and installed it pleasant young man we will use them again.
Provided fast and efficient service; as well as a friendly attitude.
